_note: Canonical 12-Step curriculum data for Refined Recovery Network. This is the single authoritative source for step titles, summary text, and scripture references, used by the homepage step cards. Each step's titleVerse is the scripture the step's own title quotes verbatim; scriptureMemory is the verse the curriculum PDF explicitly designates as that step's memorized verse. For 10 of 12 steps these are the same verse. Steps 9 and 10 are deliberate exceptions in the source PDF: their titles quote Matthew 5:24 and 1 Corinthians 11:28 respectively, but the PDF assigns each a different, non-duplicate scripture-memory verse (Proverbs 16:7 and James 4:17) rather than repeating the same passage Step 8 already owns (Matthew 5:23-24). The homepage card shows scriptureMemory; titleVerse is preserved here so the distinction is never silently lost.

steps.title: We Admitted We Were Powerless
steps.text: I admit my life is unmanageable and that apart from Christ I can do nothing on my own strength.

steps.title: Came to Believe
steps.text: I come to believe in the one true, specific God who is able to do what I could never do for myself.

steps.title: Not My Will But Thine
steps.text: I turn my will and my life over to God, saying not my will, but Thine, be done.

steps.title: Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart
steps.text: I make a fearless, honest inventory, inviting God to search my heart and try my thoughts.

steps.title: Confess Your Faults One to Another
steps.text: I confess the exact nature of my wrongs to God, to myself, and to another, that I may be healed.

steps.title: Create in Me a Clean Heart, O God
steps.text: I become entirely willing to let God remove every defect of character He reveals.

steps.title: Humble Yourselves in the Sight of the Lord
steps.text: I humbly ask God to lift me up, for He resisteth the proud and giveth grace to the humble.

steps.title: If Thou Bring Thy Gift to the Altar
steps.text: I make a list of all persons I have harmed and become willing to be reconciled to them.

steps.title: Go Thy Way — First Be Reconciled
steps.text: I go and make direct amends to those I have harmed, wherever possible, except when to do so would injure them or others.

steps.title: Let a Man Examine Himself
steps.text: I continue to take personal inventory daily, and when I am wrong, promptly admit it.

steps.title: Draw Nigh to God
steps.text: I seek through prayer and meditation to draw nigh to God, that He may draw nigh to me.

steps.title: Go Ye Into All the World
steps.text: Having examined myself and proved my faith genuine, I carry this message to others still in bondage.
